cards.referenceText: A head-up display presents essential flight information on a transparent display in the pilot's forward field of view. The pilot can see guidance, attitude, speed and other selected data while continuing to look toward the runway or outside scene. Some installations also present enhanced or synthetic vision information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 平视显示器在飞行员前方视野内的透明显示面上呈现重要飞行信息。飞行员在继续观察跑道或外部环境的同时，可以看到引导、姿态、速度和其他选定数据。部分系统还会显示增强视景或合成视景信息。

cards.audioText: Under what conditions can a HUD support operations at reduced landing minima?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么条件下，HUD 可支持按较低的着陆最低标准运行？
cards.referenceText: A HUD can support reduced-minima operations only when the aircraft, display and guidance system are approved for the specific procedure and remain serviceable. The airport facilities, weather, crew training, recent experience and operator authorization must also meet the applicable requirements. A HUD by itself does not lower published or authorized minima.
cards.referenceTextZh: 只有飞机、显示器和引导系统针对具体程序获得批准并保持可用，HUD 才能支持采用较低运行最低标准的运行。机场设施、天气、机组训练、近期经历和运营人授权也必须满足适用要求。HUD 本身不会使公布或获准的最低标准降低。

cards.audioText: Besides a HUD, what other systems can be used for approved operations at reduced landing minima?
cards.audioTextZh: 除 HUD 外，还有哪些系统可用于经批准的较低着陆最低标准运行？
cards.referenceText: Approved reduced-minima operations may use automatic landing and rollout systems, flight directors, fail-passive or fail-operational autopilots, and suitable ILS or GBAS guidance. An approved enhanced flight vision system may provide separate operational credit, and some aircraft combine it with a HUD or head-worn display. The permitted combination depends on aircraft certification, airport facilities, procedure and operator authorization.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经批准采用较低运行最低标准时，可能使用自动着陆和滑跑系统、飞行指引仪、故障后被动保护型或故障后继续工作型自动驾驶仪，以及合适的 ILS 或 GBAS 引导。经批准的增强飞行视景系统可能获得独立运行增益，部分飞机还会将其与 HUD 或头戴式显示器结合。允许使用的组合取决于飞机审定、机场设施、程序和运营人授权。

cards.audioText: When do pilots use a HUD?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员什么时候使用 HUD？
cards.referenceText: Pilots may use a HUD during takeoff, climb, approach and landing when the installation and operator procedures permit. It is especially useful when accurate flight-path guidance must be monitored while maintaining an outside view, including some low-visibility or adverse-weather operations. Crews still cross-check other instruments and use only the modes and credits for which they are trained and authorized.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在安装构型和运营人程序允许时，飞行员可以在起飞、爬升、进近和着陆阶段使用 HUD。当飞行员需要在保持外部视野的同时监控准确飞行轨迹引导时，HUD 尤其有用，包括某些低能见度或不利天气运行。机组仍应交叉检查其他仪表，而且只能使用自己受过训练并获得授权的模式和运行增益。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages of using a HUD?
cards.audioTextZh: 使用 HUD 有哪些优势？
cards.referenceText: A HUD keeps important flight information in the pilot's forward field of view, reducing the need to look down and then refocus outside. It can improve flight-path awareness, guidance tracking and the transition between instrument and visual reference. The benefit depends on good design and training because clutter or poor mode awareness can create new workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: HUD 把重要飞行信息保持在飞行员前方视野内，减少低头查看仪表再重新聚焦外部环境的需要。它可以改善飞行轨迹感知、引导跟踪以及仪表参考与目视参考之间的转换。其益处取决于良好设计和训练，因为显示杂乱或模式意识不足会增加新的工作负荷。

cards.audioText: What training must a pilot complete before using a HUD in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在飞行中使用 HUD 前必须完成哪些培训？
cards.referenceText: A pilot must complete the ground and flight or simulator training required by the aircraft, operator and operational approval. Training should cover symbology, modes, limitations, normal and failure procedures, visual transition and any reduced-minima or enhanced-vision credit. Initial qualification must be followed by the required checking, recent experience and recurrent training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员必须完成飞机、运营人和运行批准所要求的地面训练，以及飞行或模拟机训练。训练应涵盖符号、模式、限制、正常和故障程序、目视转换，以及任何与较低最低标准或增强视景有关的运行增益。取得初始资格后，还必须完成规定的检查、近期经历和复训。

cards.audioText: What operational benefits, if any, can a HUD provide when flying in heavy fog?
cards.audioTextZh: 在大雾中飞行时，HUD 是否能带来运行优势？如果能，有哪些？
cards.referenceText: In heavy fog, an approved HUD can help the pilot maintain accurate flight-path guidance while looking toward the runway environment. When combined with an approved EFVS or low-visibility guidance system, it may support authorized operational credit and a more stable visual transition. It does not make the fog disappear or permit flight below the minima and system conditions in the approval.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在大雾中，经批准的 HUD 可以帮助飞行员在观察跑道环境的同时保持准确的飞行轨迹引导。与经批准的 EFVS 或低能见度引导系统结合后，它可能支持获得批准的运行增益，并使目视转换更加稳定。它不能让雾消失，也不允许飞机低于获准的最低标准运行，或在不满足批准所规定系统条件时运行。

cards.audioText: Do you think the use of HUDs in adverse weather will become more common in the future?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为未来在不利天气中使用 HUD 会更加普遍吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I expect HUD and combined vision systems to become more common as sensors, displays and certification mature. They can improve flight-path awareness and airport access when used within approved procedures. Growth will still depend on cost, training, aircraft integration and evidence that the system improves safety without excessive complexity.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，随着传感器、显示器和审定日益成熟，我预计 HUD 和组合视景系统会更加普及。在经批准程序内使用时，它们可以改善飞行轨迹感知和机场可达性。增长速度仍取决于成本、训练、飞机集成，以及系统能够提高安全且不会带来过度复杂性的证据。
